reviewedCorrections: Two accessible Routes/Path panels share one protected Viewer and hook; mode and display-ownership generation fences reject hidden late previews and invalidate Review/Apply acknowledgement.

Route category rules are ordered with newest update winning; all rules are prepared together, empty category sets explicitly exclude selected objects, and arbitrary standalone endpoint names join bounded equipment capture.
Every category-rule edit/clear invalidates current display and blocks calculations/review until successful preparation or explicit draft discard; failures retain the dirty gate.
A successful same-model persisted snapshot rebases the prepared rule baseline after viewer cancellation; newer local drafts remain dirty. Model/selection scope changes cannot receive an old baseline.
Standalone previews preserve original From/To labels, support native defaults, reverse/cancel and explicit background transparency, and never apply cable writes.
Saved shared locations remain name-only inputs so server matching and shared-location provenance remain authoritative.
